import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1]*c+params[2]*s+params[3]+params[4]*x+params[5]*v+params[6]*v*v
            +params[7]*x**3+params[8]*c*v+params[9]*s*v)
